what: Monthly application-only founder showcase run by The Shortlist: six early-stage NYC founders present what they are building and the roles they are hiring for, followed by a mixer.
Evening meetup from the AI Alliance, sponsored by IBM and Speedsize, on LLM knowledge bases and memory for AI systems.
Panel of senior engineering leaders, hosted by Revelo, on how AI is changing engineering team structures, hiring and delivery.
Two-day API industry conference from Apidays on where APIs meet AI, covering API design for agents, MCP and API governance.
Evening of technical talks and a fireside chat on structuring AI agents in production, with speakers from Headway and Every.
Recurring live-demo night organized by ClickHouse with Langfuse, LibreChat and Docker: builders give five-minute demos of working AI projects, no slides.
Evening panel hosted by Alumni Ventures and OpenHands on deploying AI agents in the enterprise: security, privacy, governance and reliability. Speakers from OpenHands, Vercel, NVIDIA and AMD.
NYC Postgres meetup talk at Google on how AI agents use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to query and reason over Postgres data.
Evening session from Fin and Clay on bringing support, success and sales together around AI customer agents.
NY Tech Week edition of the NYC GTM Community masterclass, held at Insight Partners, on moving from solo AI-assisted go-to-market work to team- and network-wide GTM systems.
Talk from Fin's product leadership on how company-wide AI tooling changed its product velocity and led to a rebuild of its helpdesk, with a guest speaker from Anthropic.
Meetup hosted by WorkOS and Bond AI on the marketing engineer role, with speakers from Profound, Ramp, Clay, Cursor, WorkOS and Knock on using AI to build marketing systems.
Daytona's AI engineering meetup, co-hosted with Datadog, with talks from Daytona, Oracle, Blacksmith and Anchor Browser on agent infrastructure and testing.
Tenth NYC AI Demos, at The Refinery at Domino in Brooklyn: startups selected by venture firms give five-minute live demos. Hosted by Pensar with Tech:NYC and Two Trees.
Panel at Datadog's New York office on evaluating AI agents in production: reliability, regressions and drift, with researchers from Meta and Arklex.AI.
Two-day voice AI hackathon run by Agora and ScaleDown AI: a kickoff night of lightning talks and team formation, then a full build day with demos and judging.
Lightning talks hosted by Deepline and Ramp: GTM practitioners from Ramp, Modal, Notion, OpenAI and Attention on using coding agents to build go-to-market systems.
Release party from the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) for the 2026-07-28 MCP specification, with talks on the stateless spec, evaluating an MCP server and MCP authorization.
In-person RevGenius panel and happy hour at Spara's office on moving AI in revenue teams from hype to results.
Monthly application-only founder showcase run by The Shortlist: six seed-to-Series B founders present their companies and open roles, followed by a mixer.
Small evening for GTM leaders on standing out when every channel is full of AI-generated outreach: three short talks and a working session. Hosted by Vibranium Labs, MindStudio and Bond AI.
Evening meetup from AssemblyAI and LiveKit, co-hosted by Boardy: a live demo of realtime speech-to-text, then a panel on shipping voice agents in production.
Online briefing on the GLM-5.3 model with speakers from Baseten and Artificial Analysis.
Daytona's AI engineering meetup with WorkOS, You.com and Veris AI: short talks on reinforcement learning for code models, self-improving agents, simulated environments and sandboxes.
LeadDev New York community meetup, an LDX3 eXpress evening sponsored by Datadog: two talks on engineering leadership and a panel on build versus buy in the age of AI coding.
Talk from pganalyze on giving AI the Postgres performance and configuration context it needs to tune queries safely, including pganalyze's MCP server.
Online RevGenius panel with leaders from Airspeed, Clay, HubSpot and Apollo on how revenue teams turn signals into completed actions.
Clay livestream with Growth Engine X and Clay's growth team on using AI agents to run daily outbound operations.
New York stop of the GTM World Tour, a ten-city go-to-market event series from BetterContact and Scalantec, held at Clay's office.
